search: Adaptive enumeration of sets of distinct row edits from inherited radius-six neutral proposals. A new row may be selected only if reached under the current edits. Repeated edit sets deduplicated. It is not exhaustive for arbitrary interacting row changes.
target_frames: All source pcs25..44, arbitrary nine register values and nonempty arbitrary spare list; header gap>=48. Stronger than sound seeded targets.
scope: Bounded negative evidence only. No assertion of perpetual failure for bounded runs and no lower bound on state count. The individual neutral proposals include speculative arithmetic-box changes; a hypothetical hit would require a full new proof.
